sentences.text: 2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 530(C) of 2012 in which cognizance has been taken for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner contended that the marriage of O.P. No.2 was solemnized with the petitioner in the year 2011 and the complaint has been filed on 06.08.2012 just after fourteen months of the marriage.

Despite the fact that cognizance of the offence has been taken on 14.03.2013, leading Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.80614 of 2024(2) dt.04-12-2024 to issuance of summons but since the petitioner was not aware of the pendency of the complaint case nor any summons were served upon him, thus delay has occurred in approaching this Court.
It is further contended that the petitioner has always been ready to keep his wife (O.P. No.2) with full honour and dignity.
However, it is O.P. No.2, who is not inclined to live with the petitioner.
